newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to return Hamas militant remains to Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Israel to return Hamas militant remains to Gaza.

text.p: Israel will return the remains of two Palestinian Islamist militants killed in separate 1994 attacks to their families in self-ruled Gaza, Israeli security sources said on Tuesday.

They said the bodies of Salah Jadallah and Hassan Abbas, members of the Islamic Resistance Group Hamas, were exhumed from a military graveyard in northern Israel on Tuesday. They said the bodies would be transferred to the Gaza Strip on Wednesday.
Jadallah was killed when Israeli troops stormed a house where he and other militants were holding a kidnapped Israeli soldier in October 1994.
In the same month, Abbas was shot dead by Israeli paramilitary police after he and a second guerrilla opened fire on a crowded Jerusalem promenade, killing an Israeli and an Arab from East Jerusalem.
The Israeli security sources said the bodies were being returned for humanitarian reasons.
